rec: A teleport near Mudskipper Point, such as POH teleport or Fairy Ring to AIQ (2)
enemies: Able to survive attacks from Ice Warriors (level 57) and Ice Giants (level 53)
rewards: The ability to smelt Blurite ore.
The ability to smith Blurite bars.

st.t: Talk to the Squire in Falador Castle's courtyard.
s: And how is life as a squire?
I can make a new sword if you like...
So would these dwarves make another one?

st.t: Talk to Reldo in Varrock Castle's library.
s: What do you know about the Imcando dwarves?

st.t: Talk to Thurgo south of Port Sarim and give him a redberry pie.
s: Would you like a redberry pie?
Can you make a special sword for me?

st.t: Talk to the Squire in Falador Castle's courtyard.
Climb up the east ladder in Falador Castle.
Go up the staircase west of the ladder on the 1st floor.
Search the cupboard in the room south of the staircase. You'll need Sir Vyvin to be in the other room.
Go down the trapdoor east of Thurgo, south of Port Sarim. Be prepared for ice giants and ice warriors to attack you.
Inside the dungeon, follow the path west, north and then east. Keep to the southern wall in the icy area and mine a blurite ore.
Return to Thurgo with a blurite ore and two iron bars.
s: Can you make that replacement sword now?

st.t: Return to the Squire with the sword to finish the quest.
